tasks.title: Validate evidence producer and channel identity
tasks.goal: Separate evidence content integrity from authority of the producer that supplied it.
steps: Define approved local execution, authenticated channel and optional signature producer bindings with explicit schema/version.
Validate producer policy together with exact subject, operation, target and recipe; retain provenance for observational evidence that cannot authorize publication.
Implement signature verification only as an optional configured branch, preserving equivalent channel/local-trust paths; sanitize diagnostics.
positive_cases: Configured trusted local/channel evidence for the exact subject is eligible.
Optional valid signature from an approved issuer satisfies its configured policy.
negative_cases: Matching hashes from arbitrary JSON do not authorize publication.
Wrong/replayed subject, unapproved issuer and missing required channel proof refuse without revealing credentials.

Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
acceptance: Trust decision identifies both producer policy and subject.
Fixtures prove cryptographic signatures are optional rather than globally mandatory.
tasks.safe_stop: Pure evidence admission is implemented; no credentials or issuer policy changed.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(publish): validate producer authority beside release subjects
notes: Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Prepare explicit source verification and PR pipeline
tasks.goal: Connect requested source checks to their actual producer while keeping CI deployment a separate approved action.
steps: Map existing self-check and distribution commands; implement a local verification request/receipt that records exactly which source checks were requested and executed.
Prepare a reviewable CI workflow patch in the task evidence directory, showing trusted versus untrusted job inputs, credential boundary, captured outputs and optional signing path.
Validate the receipt flow with local fixtures; deliver the exact proposed CI patch and external-effect inventory to the root for a separate scoped CI-change packet.
positive_cases: An explicitly requested check run attaches real results to the exact source subject.
A build with no full-test request stays truthful and does not falsely claim tests ran.
negative_cases: Untrusted PR work cannot receive publish credentials or a release-authoritative signer.
Pending CI approval cannot be reported as an installed/proven live pipeline.

tasks.title: Install the explicitly approved CI producer configuration
tasks.goal: Complete the real PR/source verification pipeline only after its concrete CI-change batch is authorized.
steps: Consume the prepared workflow diff from .2 and exact current-A authority for the named CI configuration changes; absent approval leaves this task pending.
Apply only the approved workflow/provider boundary changes, preserving action pins and excluding credentials from untrusted jobs.
Observe a real authorized verification run or explicitly record remaining external execution debt; validate produced subject/channel receipts using .1, with no publication as a side effect.
positive_cases: Approved CI configuration emits evidence accepted for its exact protected subject/channel.
Explicit source checks run only when requested/configured in the approved flow.
negative_cases: Unapproved workflow mutation or credential exposure is forbidden.
Prepared YAML or a local fake cannot be claimed as a completed live pipeline.
